info.name: Food Delivery API
info.description:
Walks the ordering workflow: the menu with filters, menu management, order validation, totals with tax and delivery fee, the double-click guard, the kitchen's step-by-step status changes, cancellation rules, the sales dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8101). Repeatable: it registers a fresh customer and a uniquely named dish each run.

item.name: Register a fresh customer for this run
Customers see only dishes that are on

exec: pm.test("Many dishes, all active, none sold out", () => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.least(20); pm.expect(list.every(m => m.active)).to.be.true; pm.expect(list.some(m => m.name === "Mutton Rogan Josh")).to.be.false; });
pm.test("Only desserts", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.be.at.least(3); pm.expect(l.every(m => m.category === "DESSERTS")).to.be.true; });

item.name: A quantity of zero is rejected
A bad phone and a short address are rejected

exec: pm.test("Both explained", () => { const e = pm.response.json().fieldErrors; pm.expect(e.address).to.include("10 to 200"); pm.expect(e.phone).to.include("10 digit"); });

item.name: The same dish twice is rejected
A sold-out dish cannot be ordered
Below the minimum order is rejected

exec: pm.test("Totals come from the menu: 680 + 34 tax, no delivery fee", () => { pm.expect(o.subtotal).to.eql(680); pm.expect(o.tax).to.eql(34); pm.expect(o.deliveryFee).to.eql(0); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(714); });

pm.test("Placed, with lines and the next step", () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("PLACED"); pm.expect(o.nextStatus).to.eql("ACCEPTED"); pm.expect(o.lines.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(o.itemCount).to.eql(4); pm.expect(o.number).to.match(/^FD-\d+$/); pm.expect(o.canCancel).to.be.true; });

item.name: The same order again is a double click

exec: pm.test("Points at the first order", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("just placed"));

item.name: A small order pays the delivery fee

exec: pm.test("280 + 14 tax + 40 delivery = 334", () => { pm.expect(o.subtotal).to.eql(280); pm.expect(o.tax).to.eql(14); pm.expect(o.deliveryFee).to.eql(40); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(334); });
pm.test("Two, newest first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].id).to.be.above(l[1].id); });

item.name: Another customer sees none of them
The restaurant sees the new orders first

exec: pm.test("Both orders, with the customer's phone and address", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].phone).to.eql("9876543210"); pm.expect(l[0].address).to.include("Baner"); });
pm.test("Says the next step", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("can only move to ACCEPTED"));

pm.test("Accepted by the restaurant, no longer cancellable", () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("ACCEPTED"); pm.expect(o.acceptedBy).to.eql("restaurant"); pm.expect(o.canCancel).to.be.false; pm.expect(o.nextStatus).to.eql("PREPARING"); });

item.name: The customer sees it being prepared

exec: pm.test("Preparing with times", () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("PREPARING"); pm.expect(o.acceptedAt).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(o.preparingAt).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Another customer cannot open the order
A ready order cannot be rejected
A delivered order cannot move on
It shows in the delivered list
It is now a past order for the customer

exec: pm.test("Delivered one is past", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(o => o.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("order1"))).to.be.true);

pm.test("Cancelled by the customer", () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(o.cancelReason).to.eql("Changed my mind"); pm.expect(o.cancelledBy).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: The customer can no longer cancel
The restaurant must give a reason to reject

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the restaurant", () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(o.cancelledBy).to.eql("restaurant"); });
